methodSections.heading: Cashew Dressing
steps: Soak the cashews in water for at least an hour and then drain.
Add all ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth, about a minute. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

methodSections.heading: Burrito Salsa
steps: Dice the tomato and onion, roughly chop the cilantro and parsley, mince the garlic and slice the jalapeño finely.
Mix all the ingredients together in a bowl. Season to taste.

methodSections.heading: Bowl Assembly
steps: Arrange a layer of salad mix in each serving bowl and top with a layer of cabbage.
Next add the rice, corn and yams.
Dress with the salsa and cashew dressing.

methodSections.heading: Spanish Rice
steps: Dice the onion and mince the garlic.

Add all ingredients to a rice cooker and cook on the brown rice setting. Alternatively, bring to a boil in a saucepan, reduce the heat, cover and cook until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender.

methodSections.heading: Roasted Yams
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line a baking tray with parchment paper.
Dice the yams and toss in the oil then spread evenly on the lined tray.
Bake for 15 minutes until golden brown. Allow to cool before serving.

methodSections.heading: Spiced Roasted Corn
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line a baking tray with parchment paper.
Mix all of the ingredients together in a mixing bowl and then spread out evenly on the lined tray. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Bake for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Allow to cool before serving.
